packageRules.description: DHI (dhi.io) is a pull-through proxy fronting registry.docker.io. Renovate resolves dhi.io image digests against dhi.io but misroutes tag/version discovery to index.docker.io (Docker Hub library/*), which carries no -debian13 variants, so version lookups return no-result (surfaced as a 'Package lookup failures' dashboard warning) and a major-line bump like 19-debian13 would never surface. The registryAliases self-mapping does not redirect tag discovery; this explicit registryUrls does. Covers dhi.io/postgres and dhi.io/nats.

tmp's historical 0.0.4 metadata has a non-spec array `repository` field that fails Renovate's strict npm Zod schema (repository lacks the .catch() leniency homepage has), aborting the whole package lookup with a 'Package lookup failures: no-result' warning. tmp here is only a transitive security pin via overrides, already at the latest 0.2.7, so there is nothing to update; disable lookup to keep the dashboard clean.

Cap the undici overrides pin at 7.x. jsdom (Vitest's DOM test environment) self-requires undici ^7.25.0, and the web/package.json overrides block forces every undici instance (including jsdom's nested copy) to one version, so an 8.x override would violate jsdom's own constraint and break the test environment. Capping at <8 keeps undici inside the grouped Web dependencies PR while tracking the newest 7.x patch/minor, and stops Renovate re-proposing the 8.x major every cycle. Lift when jsdom depends on undici 8.
Python dependencies (pep621 + pre-commit). Footprint: pyproject.toml, uv.lock, .pre-commit-config.yaml. Disjoint from Web and Infrastructure groups.

Web dependencies (npm). Footprint: web/, site/, .github/package.json + their lockfiles. Disjoint from Python (pyproject.toml/uv.lock) and Infrastructure (.github/workflows/*.yml, never .github/package.json).

Infrastructure dependencies. Single group spanning Go modules, Dockerfile + docker-compose images, GitHub Actions SHAs, and every custom-regex pin (binary-tool versions, container-image regexes for state.go / compose.yml / busybox / testcontainers, action version: inputs, go install URLs). Footprint: cli/, docker/, .github/workflows/*, .github/actions/*, scripts/install_*, cli/internal/config/state.go, tests/*.py testcontainers pins. One group with no carve-outs guarantees zero source/config overlap with the Python and Web groups; without it, an action SHA bump and a `version:` input bump for the same tool can land in two PRs that both modify the same workflow line, and a Dockerfile base-image bump for `golang` can desync from the matching cli/go.mod toolchain bump.

Combine all lock-file maintenance (pep621, pre-commit, npm, gomod) into a single weekly PR. Lockfile-only overlap with the three dep groups is structural and accepted -- the bot rebases the loser of each lockfile race on its next cycle.
Do not pin requires-python -- it is a compatibility range, not a dependency

Lycheeverse/lychee upstream tags are `lychee-v<x.y.z>`; the bare `v<x.y.z>` form is what `lycheeverse/lychee-action`'s `version:` input expects and what `scripts/install_cli_tools.sh` stores. Strip the prefix from upstream so Renovate's semver comparator lines up with the stored value.
Block Python 3.15+ in Docker images (policy decision)

Block opentelemetry-* >=1.41.0 while logfire pins opentelemetry-sdk<1.41.0 (see logfire pyproject.toml on main). Without this, every Renovate run produces a grouped Python PR whose uv.lock regeneration fails. Lift the cap when logfire releases a version that allows OTel 1.41+.

docker/compose.yml mirrors image pins whose canonical source-of-truth lives in cli/internal/config/state.go (Default*ImageTag) and cli/internal/verify/dhi.go (dhiPinnedIndexDigests) for DHI postgres + nats, and in cli/internal/compose/compose.yml.tmpl for busybox. Letting the docker-compose manager update docker/compose.yml independently produces upgrade-collision warnings when the custom regex managers land on a different newValue, which aborts the entire branch. The custom regex managers are the single update path; a Go test verifies docker/compose.yml stays in sync. Other dev compose files (overlays, dast, distributed, fine-tuning) keep the docker-compose manager.
Ignore test golden files -- not real compose configs

customManagers.description: Binary tool version env vars in CI workflows and local dev install scripts (Trivy, Grype, Gitleaks, D2, apko, melange, lychee, etc.)
go install binary versions in CI workflows and local dev setup scripts

DHI postgres+nats image pins in docker/compose.yml. The runtime compose.yml is generated from cli/internal/compose/compose.yml.tmpl using Go template variables ({{.PostgresImageTag}}, {{.NATSImageTag}}, {{.PostgresDigest}}, {{.NATSDigest}}) driven by state.go's Default*Image{Tag,Digest} constants, so the template file holds no literals to match and does not need scanning. docker/compose.yml is the static dev/DAST compose file whose literal `image:` lines must stay in lockstep with state.go (enforced by cli/internal/verify/compose_sync_test.go). Renovate's docker-compose manager is disabled on docker/compose.yml (see packageRules above) so the state.go customManager (below) was previously the only update path, leaving docker/compose.yml hand-mirrored. This manager closes that gap: the same (depName, currentValue, currentDigest) tuple Renovate resolves for state.go now also rewrites docker/compose.yml in the same PR.

Busybox sidecar in dev compose files. Covers both the runtime template (compose.yml.tmpl) and docker/compose.yml. Renovate's docker-compose manager is disabled on docker/compose.yml (see packageRules), so this custom manager is the single update path; both files share one regex so Renovate makes a single docker-datasource lookup per (tag, digest) pair.

DHI image pins for postgres + nats. Tag AND digest both live in cli/internal/config/state.go as Default*Image{Tag,Digest} constants; cli/internal/verify/dhi.go derives its dhiPinnedIndexDigests map from those constants at init. One file, one regex shape, one match per dep -- Renovate makes a single docker-datasource lookup per (depName, currentValue) pair and writes both tag+digest in the same edit. Splitting tag+digest across two regex shapes (one capturing currentDigest, the other not) triggers https://github.com/renovatebot/renovate/issues/36461 ('Multiple changed values') and aborts the renovate/container branch with 'Error updating branch: update failure'.

Testcontainers image pins in Python integration tests. Anchored on a `# renovate: datasource=docker depName=...` marker on the line above a `DockerContainer("name:tag")` (or any `Foo("name:tag")`) call. Renovate cannot scan Python source strings without this; without coverage, the testcontainers pin in tests/integration/communication/test_bus_nats.py drifts away from the upstream image and the test silently runs against an outdated runtime.
